digest.component_or_area: rebar lifecycle enforcement and policy gating
propositions: Enable verify.enforce_plan_material_pins and verify.require_plan_review_for_close in rebar.toml while retaining false defaults in reusable configuration schema.
Prove end-to-end lifecycle that stale material-pin drift rejects claim or close with exit code 1 and names the canonical stale target.
Prove missing or incompatible phase close-plan review rejects close with exit code 1 and instructs operator to run review-plan.
Verify unchanged successful re-review produces no further propagation downstream and in-progress self-edit invalidates close until fresh execution review obtained.
Demonstrate enable/disable/re-enable behavior, depends_on and blocks canonicalization, code-only drift at close, and deleted/archived target handling through public lifecycle surfaces.
Verify no eager backfill, graph-wide invalidation event, new pin command, list-output change, or stored relation migration occurs.
